name: Drag-and-Drop Dashboard Canvas
purposeNote: A business analyst can visually construct a dashboard without coding.
patternReason: A canvas edited and saved as a whole (`updateDashboard` replaces the tiles), drawn 2 October 2026 from the client's dashboard specification (MATRIX 8.7.12: grid, gallery, data pane, field wells, formatting); CHG-SOT-010.
purpose: Provide the main visual workspace for dashboard construction.

gaps.why: **No draft, preview-publish or rollback for a dashboard** (design-notes correction ANL-023, MATRIX 7.1.46). Every save overwrites the live dashboard; the contract has no dashboard version or publish operation. Undo and redo are drawn as session-only. Logged as a contract gap 2 October 2026 (CHG-SOT-016).

components.label: Save dashboard
components.notes: **The first Save creates the dashboard (`createDashboard`), every later Save updates it (`updateDashboard`)** (decided by Chinmay, 3 October 2026 (CHG-SPF-011)); the refresh budget is checked on both. Saves the whole dashboard (tiles replace tiles); the confirmation names tiles that will be removed. Refused 422 `tile-encoding-missing` for a tile whose report lacks a well its mark requires, naming the tile and the well.

components.label: Undo
components.notes: Undo the last change on the canvas, in this editing session only. Nothing is saved until Save dashboard.

components.label: Redo
components.notes: Redo, in this editing session only.

components.label: Cancel
components.notes: **A screen that can submit must be leaveable without submitting.** Discards unsaved changes after saying how many.

components.label: Archive dashboard
components.notes: Archives rather than removes (`archivedAt`); the confirmation names the dashboard and its tile count.

components.label: Visuals
components.notes: **All twenty marks of `DashboardTile.visualisation`, the nine complex ones included** (decided 2 October 2026, Chinmay: "Build all chart types, including the nine complex ones"; DEC-080, CHG-FIN-007): number, line, area, bar, stackedBar, stackedBar100, combo, pie, donut, table, matrix, gauge, heatmap, funnel, waterfall, treemap, scatter, map, ribbon and decompositionTree. Each card names the wells its mark requires (the binding table in the contract): combo an x dimension and two or more measures with axis and series type; matrix rows, optional columns and values; funnel ordered stages and a value; waterfall ordered steps and a value, total last; treemap categories with levels and a size; scatter x, y and a label; map a location and a value; ribbon a period, a series and a value; decomposition tree a value and two or more levels. Slicers and narrative text are not marks (`x-ticvai-refuses`).

components.label: Find a report
components.notes: Sends `?search=`; the data pane lists the reports a tile may bind, by category.

components.label: Reports and their columns
components.notes: Each report opens to its columns with `role`, `encoding`, `axis`, `seriesType`, `hierarchyLevel` and `unitLabel` (CHG-FIN-007); a column is dragged into a well.

components.label: Canvas
components.notes: A grid; each tile sits at `position` (row, column, width, height). **At most 24 tiles.** Every tile renders its mark with live data, shows its as-of time and a stale warning past its refresh (BOARDREQ MOM-2713/2714).

components.label: Field wells
components.notes: The wells of the selected tile's mark, filled from its report's columns. A required well left empty is named in red, and Save is refused for it rather than drawing an empty chart.

components.label: Refresh every (seconds)
components.notes: Minimum 30.

components.label: Formatting
components.notes: The tile's run parameters and display settings (for `number`: comparison, variance, sparkline and status icon).

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed (the dashboard or a report) and leaves the canvas as it was.
states.emptyFirstRun: A new dashboard with no tiles yet. The gallery is open and says "Drag a visual onto the grid"; nothing is created until Save dashboard.
states.emptyNoResults: The report search matched nothing. Names the search and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `REPORT_VIEW_VENUE`, which `listReports` requires to show this screen, and names that permission. A caller without `REPORT_MANAGE` sees the dashboard read-only: Save (`createDashboard`, `updateDashboard`) and Archive (`deleteDashboard`) are disabled and name that permission (decided by Chinmay, 3 October 2026 (CHG-SPF-011)).

notes: **The nine new marks bind** (decided 2 October 2026, Chinmay; CHG-FIN-007). The canvas offers all twenty marks of `DashboardTile.visualisation` and, for each, field wells filled from the report's columns (`ReportColumn.role`, `encoding`, `axis`, `seriesType`, `hierarchyLevel`, `unitLabel`): combo (x, bars and lines, primary and secondary axis with units), matrix (rows, columns, values, with drill levels), funnel (ordered stages, value), waterfall (ordered steps of a measure set, total last), treemap (nested categories, size, colour), scatter (x, y, label, size, colour), map (venue, zone or map point, value), ribbon (period, series, value) and decomposition tree (value, levels). A tile whose report lacks a required well cannot be saved (422 `tile-encoding-missing`). At most 24 tiles; every tile shows its as-of time and a stale warning past its refresh (BOARDREQ MOM-2713/2714).

overlays.body: **Names what the save removes**, because the tiles are replaced as a whole ("Save and remove 2 tiles: Refunds by channel, Queue time"). Dismissing keeps editing.
Names the dashboard and its tile count; archived dashboards leave the library unless asked for. Dismissing sends nothing.

**The first Save of a new dashboard** (decided by Chinmay, 3 October 2026 (CHG-SPF-011)): names it and creates it with `createDashboard`, tiles and all; every later Save goes straight to `updateDashboard`. The refresh budget is checked here too. Dismissing sends nothing; the canvas keeps its tiles.

name: KPI Builder
purposeNote: Administrators can centrally define reusable KPIs and ensure the same KPI calculation is used across TICVAI dashboards.
patternReason: the pack gives this screen a configuration directory (§Configure; Define whether) and no display directory — it is settings, not a population
purpose: Allow authorized business users to create standardized enterprise KPIs.

gaps.why: **No update or retire operation for a KPI** (design-notes correction ANL-025). `createKpi` writes one; nothing corrects or retires it, so a mistake cannot be put right. Logged as a contract gap 2 October 2026 (CHG-SOT-016). The earlier gap ("declares no operation that writes anything") was stale: the screen declares `createKpi`.

components.label: KPI code
components.notes: Unique in the tenant; the seeded codes (`takings`, `admissions`, the finance measures) are taken.

components.label: Business domain
components.notes: The semantic model's domains.

components.label: Formula
components.notes: **Against the semantic model, not tables.** The measure, the aggregation and the data source are all in the formula; there are no separate fields for them.

components.label: Unit
components.notes: Currency, count, percentage, duration, ratio or score. Currency and decimal places follow the region (AED 2, BHD/KWD/OMR 3), not the KPI.

components.label: Higher is better
components.notes: One yes/no. Examples, not fields: revenue and conversion up is better; refund rate, gate rejection rate and queue time down is better.

components.label: Active
components.notes: The KPI's status: inactive KPIs are kept and not offered on dashboards.

components.label: KPIs already defined
components.notes: The seeded KPIs first (takings, admissions and the finance measures, CHG-FIN-007), then the tenant's own.

components.label: Create KPI
components.notes: Defines it once, for every dashboard and report.
